$Comment: Invisible flag on a player hit by one of the Ice King's quick hits (2026-10-21: zap, punches, nunchuck hits 1-2). AT_Ice_King_Frost_Half_Hit: without it the hit only puts it on; with it the hit clears it and adds one real frost stack (AT_Ice_King_Frost_Hit), so two quick hits = one stack. Same 20 s as the frost stacks (set by the interaction).
